Game Overview

In Kite Flying, the core idea is straightforward: maneuver your kite gracefully through endless skies in "Kite Flying," where thrilling aerial duels and unpredictable weather challenge your agility. Stay alert and strategically navigate to outsmart opponents, scoring points as you dodge obstacles and combat unpredictable winds. Embrace the sky's ever-changing battleground and soar to victory.
